steps.title: Drafting and Filing of Plaint
steps.description: Plaint is drafted and filed before the appropriate civil court in accordance with the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, within the prescribed limitation period.

steps.title: Scrutiny and Registration of Suit
steps.description: Court scrutinizes the plaint and registers the civil suit if it complies with procedural requirements.

steps.title: Issuance of Summons
steps.description: Summons are issued to the defendant to appear and file a written statement.

steps.title: Filing of Written Statement
steps.description: Defendant submits a written statement responding to the allegations in the plaint.

steps.title: Framing of Issues
steps.description: Court frames issues based on pleadings of both parties to determine points for adjudication.

steps.title: Evidence Stage
steps.description: Parties lead oral and documentary evidence in support of their respective cases.

steps.title: Final Arguments
steps.description: Both parties present final arguments before the court.

steps.title: Judgment
steps.description: Court pronounces judgment based on evidence and arguments.

steps.title: Decree and Execution
steps.description: Decree is drawn up and may be executed if not complied with voluntarily.

escalation_paths.condition: First appeal or second appeal as permitted under the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908
Civil appeal or Special Leave Petition as permitted by law
